hypothesis: A fixed anatomical reference with a single virtual-work feedback objective can be maintained by the existing force-based native motors. This is an unvalidated local feedback baseline, not MPC.

physical.startup: Unmodified createEmbodiedCharacter initialization; reference changes never change body state.

budget.rationale: Three small fore-aft references, four signed local perturbations and the six existing H42 controls; finite scope before prediction.

reference.selection: First passing reference in this order; no retuning within this version.
reference.rationale: Half the official foot drift and 20% speed reserves permit a small return neighborhood. Headroom is a bounded native-request proxy; delivered torque is unavailable and no delivered-effort claim follows.

controller.rationale: Retain production posture gains and gravity/load feedforward. Sum fixed-foot virtual work, parent pelvis reaction, every segment's motion damping and torque regularization once, with the original anatomical axis caps. No copied-world search at runtime.

local.state: All 25 measured poses and velocities, native joint coordinates, bilateral measured sole contacts; fixed reference and latched failure state.
local.control: Existing anatomical motor axes only; finite force-based native commands.
local.model: None. Prediction evaluation is blocked until reference and local return pass.
local.rationale: Four physical impulses test a small signed neighborhood without setters. No validated backup region is assumed.

sustained.rationale: Four times the official window, independently repeated, with the same limits throughout.

heldOut.applicationPoint: Measured segment center of mass; force implemented as force * 1/60 impulse each tick.
heldOut.rationale: Separate uncalibrated headings and physical body/hand disturbances. These never count as undisturbed acceptance.

runtime.browser: Installed browser version must be captured before application gate; unavailable version blocks that gate.
runtime.instrumentation: performance.now around controller and complete fixedUpdate; artifact I/O measured separately; p50/p95/p99/max; application requires actual browser path.

memory.measurement: Node process.memoryUsage RSS/heapUsed/external/arrayBuffers separately; WASM linear buffer byteLength separately, never sum overlapping totals. Browser gate requires a total-process measurement, not JS heap alone.

failurePolicy.timeout: Latch failure and hand motor authority to the existing balance/fall/recovery path in the same update.
failurePolicy.infeasible: Same bounded transition; never silently reuse an unvalidated command.
failurePolicy.invalidContactOrState: Same transition; no reentry without explicit Reset.
failurePolicy.backup: No validated backup in v1. Reuse and backup requests are rejected and cause the same transition. Existing balance is a transition policy, not an accepted standing backup.
failurePolicy.reserve: Reserves only assess reference quality; missing a preferred reserve cannot exclude a mandatory-valid command.
